context_visible: Aerial view of a densely populated settlement adjacent to a wide river.

The immediate shoreline is irregular, consisting of exposed earth, rocks, and scattered debris.
A paved road runs along the left edge of the settlement, and a bridge is visible in the far distance.
Vegetation is sparse, with mostly leafless trees indicating a dormant season.

The cluster of buildings in the crop corresponds to the structures situated directly on the bank of the water in the context view.
The debris field visible in the crop is part of the shoreline accumulation seen in the wider shot.

evidence_visible: Close-up of a dense cluster of residential buildings with flat and pitched roofs.
Roof materials include grey tiles, concrete, and red/orange tiles.
A small, walled garden plot with a grid pattern is visible between buildings.

A small blue structure is visible on the far right edge of the crop.
